audit_items.proof_trace: publish_column_sidecars computes subnet via DataColumnSubnetId::from_column_index and publishes without verifying node subscription. The libp2p.publish() method (lighthouse_network/src/service/mod.rs:838) has no subscription guard. Publishing succeeds on any subnet regardless of custody/sampling membership.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Locally-built block publisher publishes all 128 data columns to their computed subnets via HTTP API, even if node only has custody of a small subset (e.g., 4 columns). This violates the sampling invariant and can trigger peer penalties or bandwidth amplification.
